title: callicarpa candicans var. integrifolia
intro: Callicarpa candicans var. integrifolia, commonly known as the Purple Fruit Vine, is a flowering plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its vibrant purple berries, which are rich in antioxidants and possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Callicarpa candicans var. integrifolia include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other antioxidants, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
